text:
QUOTE: Stated scope from a tool call (tier 1) goes through the same construction as a written declaration, and only the reason text differs.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer only mentions that "reason text differs" in passing; it never says the fallback carries a reason explaining which scope was used and why, so an unstated scope is never silently guessed. The rejected-declaration fallback is described as logged, not as carrying a reason.
